name: sdlc
description: End-to-end issue orchestration: the /sdlc:orchestrate-ready grooming skill, the /sdlc:orchestrate flow, the /sdlc:orchestrate-cleanup pass that deletes merged and closed PRs' review state, and the /sdlc:orchestrate-analysis time report, configured through three tiers written by /sdlc:sdlc-config-global, /sdlc:sdlc-config-repo and /sdlc:sdlc-config-user, plus the issue-developer, issue-fixer, code-documenter, style-checker, docs-writer, agent-memory-scrubber, pr-merge-readiness, pr-finalizer, and pr-monitor agents, and a theorem-based PR review pipeline run by the theorem-based-pr-reviewer agent and built from a theorem-generator (low, medium, high, and xhigh effort tiers), parallel theorem-disprovers, and parallel counterexample-verifiers.
